note: Reviewed adjudications for rows the gate cannot resolve from the data alone. Row numbers are valid only for the CSV named above. Rows where two of the three classification signals agree are resolved automatically and need no entry here. Every decision below was made against the product image.

rationale: Image shows silver ballet-style pumps with a round toe and bow on a visible mid stiletto heel. The product name 'Ballet Heels' is accurate. Two enrichment runs disagreed (v2 read flats, full run read heels); the image settles it as heels. The live catalog currently files this under footwear/flats, which is wrong.

name: Kaleidoscope Floral Print Skirt
rationale: Image shows a white floral maxi skirt worn with a separate top and a visible waistband. The merchant subcategory column already said 'skirt' and the image agrees; only the product name said 'Dress'. Correcting the name makes the record coherent. The contradicted merchant description is suppressed because it describes a dress.

Image shows a gold metal aviator frame with brown mocha gradient lenses. Enrichment published the frame colour; the lenses dominate the product visually and the merchant name says Mocha, so brown is the colour a shopper would filter on.

Image shows very dark navy suede pumps; the blue cast is visible on the toe and sides where light catches, and they match the navy trousers in shot rather than reading as neutral black. The merchant name and description both say navy. Enrichment read them as black, which dark navy suede photographs as under warm light.

Image shows a black acetate frame with navy-to-teal gradient lenses. Enrichment published the frame colour. Following the same convention as row 62, the lenses dominate the product and the merchant name says Navy, so navy is the colour a shopper would filter on.

Image shows a closed-upper espadrille with a closed heel and sides, a jute rope sole and a peep toe. It is a flat, not a strappy sandal. The v3 enrichment read it as sandals; the previous catalog had flats, which is correct.

Rows 30 and 38 are both named Kaleidoscope Crossbody Bag and share one image at different prices. Publishing both shows shoppers two identically named products with the same photo. Row 38 is kept; this row is removed pending a distinct image or a merge.

Image shows a cream/oatmeal cable-knit sweater, and the enriched description already says cream-coloured. Enrichment published 'other', which for a filterable field behaves as no value at all. Beige is the closest enum value and matches how the other cream products are classified.
